name: Hertz Global Holdings
hero_kpi_rationale: HTZ est exposée à un risque de taux d'intérêt significatif du fait de sa structure d'endettement variable importante. Une augmentation hypothétique d'un point de pourcentage des taux d'intérêt réduirait les résultats d'exploitation de 48 millions de dollars sur douze mois, ce qui représente un facteur clé pour la viabilité financière de l'entreprise.

kpis.name_fr: Sensibilité au risque de taux d'intérêt
kpis.explanation: Potential pre-tax operating results impact from a one percentage point increase in interest rates on the debt portfolio, cash equivalents and investments as of December 31, 2025, over a twelve-month period.
kpis.signal: Impact de 48 millions de dollars sur les résultats d'exploitation pré-impôt en cas de hausse de 1% des taux d'intérêt.
kpis.description: HTZ détient un portefeuille significatif de dettes à taux variable basé sur SOFR, EURIBOR et autres indices de référence plus une marge applicable. Une augmentation d'un point de pourcentage des taux d'intérêt sur ce portefeuille réduirait les résultats d'exploitation pré-impôt estimés de 48 millions de dollars sur une période de douze mois.

kpis.name_en: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Risk Sensitivity
kpis.explanation: Potential impact on pre-tax operating results from a one percentage point change in foreign currency exchange rates on intercompany loan balances as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Impact de 4 millions de dollars sur les résultats d'exploitation pré-impôt en cas de variation de 1% des taux de change.
kpis.description: HTZ est exposée aux fluctuations des taux de change, principalement avec l'Euro, le dollar canadien, le dollar australien et la livre sterling résultant des transactions intercompagnies et autres obligations en devises. Une variation d'un point de pourcentage des taux de change sur le solde des prêts intercompagnies réduirait les résultats d'exploitation pré-impôt estimés de 4 millions de dollars.

ai_positioning.summary: HTZ mentions potential incorporation of AI solutions into business operations and acknowledges associated risks including reputational harm, competitive harm and legal liability.
evidence: We may incorporate AI solutions into our business, and we may leverage AI, including generative AI, into our business operations.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: HTZ carries significant variable-rate debt (SOFR, EURIBOR based). A 1% rate increase reduces pre-tax operating results by $48M annually. Material impact given debt-heavy capital structure.
risks.summary: Interest rate exposure on $48M+ of debt portfolio creates material financial risk. HTZ uses interest rate swaps and caps to manage exposure, but rising rates significantly impact profitability.

risks.title: Foreign Currency Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: FX exposure to Euro, CAD, AUD, GBP on intercompany loans. 1% FX movement impacts pre-tax results by ~$4M. Lower severity due to natural hedging through local operations.
risks.summary: FX exposure managed primarily through incurring operating and financing expenses in local currencies, with estimated $4M impact from 1% FX movement on intercompany balances.

risks.title: AI Integration and Governance
risks.score_rationale: HTZ may incorporate AI/generative AI into operations. Risks include reputational harm, competitive disadvantage, legal liability and operational failures. Language indicates acknowledged but not yet material concern.
risks.summary: HTZ acknowledges potential integration of AI solutions but risks remain exploratory. Must address governance, transparency and liability concerns as AI adoption progresses.

risks.title: Internal Control Over Financial Reporting
risks.score_rationale: HTZ notes inherent limitations in internal controls including human error, circumvention risks and fraud potential. Material weakness would impact financial reporting reliability and regulatory compliance.
risks.summary: Effective internal controls are essential to financial reporting accuracy. HTZ acknowledges inherent limitations and must maintain adequate controls to prevent misstatement and fraud.

risks.title: Competitive Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Car rental market is highly competitive with major players (Avis, Budget, Enterprise) and new entrants. Pricing pressure and market consolidation are ongoing concerns.
risks.summary: HTZ operates in competitive vehicle rental market. Must maintain service quality, pricing competitiveness and customer loyalty to preserve market position.
